purpose: Visual evidence and dependency map derived from GPT-Knowledge plus explicitly verified current GitHub and runtime evidence. This is navigation state, not runtime authority.
authority_rule: Current repository source, local runtime evidence, acceptance results, and exact repository state outrank this map. Historical checkpoints remain historical unless revalidated on the current head.

nodes.title: Single local reasoning agent
nodes.summary: Browser/provider conversation supplies instructions; AgentSessionRuntime / LiveAgentCore owns reasoning and tool selection. Bridges transport; governance constrains authority.

nodes.title: Provider-neutral authority boundary
nodes.summary: Provider identity, authentication, discovery, readiness and explicit activation are separate from Access session/tool/browser/evidence authority. LM Studio remains first-class and Cline is a reusable lower-layer provider path.

nodes.title: Managed browser authority
nodes.summary: Managed Chrome/CDP and BrowserSessionAuthority own browser lifecycle, target identity, exact-chat selection, reconnect and Browser Loop readiness gating.

nodes.title: Exact-chat transport
nodes.summary: Transport owns identity, ordering, deduplication, journaling and same-conversation delivery; it is not a second reasoning loop.

nodes.title: Governed tools and evidence
nodes.summary: ToolRegistry / LiveToolContext own governed workspace and execution capabilities with evidence and receipts.

nodes.title: rebuild-main → main runtime
nodes.summary: package.json points to electron/rebuild-main.js, which wraps and loads electron/main.js. createConfiguredAgentRuntime restores persisted provider settings into the runtime.

nodes.title: Production settings owner
nodes.summary: electron/index.html directly loads electron/rebuild-settings.js. This was already true in initial canonical commit 5d77a0e8. electron/settings-module.js is parallel/historical in the current rebuild shell.

nodes.title: Active provider state owner
nodes.summary: AgentRuntimeAdapter _installProvider() changes service.provider, service.agent.provider and providerSelection. discoverOnly creates a candidate without installing it.

nodes.title: Candidate readiness owner mapped
nodes.summary: ModelReadinessRegistry keys readiness by full provider selection identity. ProviderFactory creates candidates independently. The readiness algorithm can operate on a supplied provider object without requiring service.provider mutation.

nodes.title: Browser Loop readiness gate
nodes.summary: BrowserSessionAuthority validates the active provider/model, performs recovery-only preflight when required, probes readiness, then enters normal relay operation. No evidence supports weakening this gate.

nodes.title: Historical provider context bounded
nodes.summary: bb00c560 plus 48130876 bounds only rehydrated historical tool-result content in provider-facing context. Current-live protected-context Browser Loop revalidation succeeded.

nodes.title: Cline auth source authority repaired
nodes.summary: Auth persistence/source ownership repair series 11b06af through 79253b5 passed focused source/regression checks. Live OAuth persistence remains separate because no successful sign-in credential was created.

nodes.title: Next assistant turn misclassified
nodes.summary: Live diagnostics proved the first assistant turn after result delivery was detected but consumed as delivery_response rather than submitted as the next instruction.

nodes.title: Post-result continuation repaired
nodes.summary: fab58f2 resolves delivery ownership without returning early; a553fe9 regression proves immediate next-turn execution semantics with newSession:false and preserved restart fail-closed guard.

nodes.title: Candidate readiness without activation
nodes.summary: c8ed189 current main passed local syntax checks, provider-candidate-readiness-authority-smoke, Cline provider smoke and IDE preferences smoke. Candidate pass/fail probes leave active provider A unchanged and cache candidate B readiness under B. Production Cline Test READY is non-authoritative; Use remains explicit activation.

nodes.title: Provider-test authority regression
nodes.summary: Regression and source contract passed locally at c8ed189, proving candidate readiness does not mutate service.provider, service.agent.provider or providerSelection in either success or failure cases.

nodes.title: A → result → B current-live proof
nodes.summary: PROVEN_CURRENT_LIVE on c8ed189. A turn-5b6f2c0b8e51486d executed and returned BLOCKED; B turn-f654f1aa23c0959d was automatically ingested next and completed; C turn-68937c9ad218187b was automatically ingested again and reached governed runCommand. Subsequent assistant turns are no longer swallowed as delivery_response.

nodes.title: Test READY previously mutated active provider
nodes.summary: Before c8ed189, active rebuild-settings.js Test READY called providerConfigure without discoverOnly, causing _installProvider() to replace the live provider while persist:false left durable preference unchanged. Present since initial canonical commit 5d77a0e8; now repaired and regression-protected.

nodes.title: Reference contract predates Access baseline
nodes.summary: GPT-Knowledge provider-neutral/Cline reuse guidance was added 2026-08-13 before the current canonical Access repository snapshot. Current Cline/VS Code patterns also keep explicit provider selection distinct from discovery/configuration.

nodes.title: Non-complete terminal UI truth
nodes.summary: Validate that genuine non-complete outcomes are rendered truthfully in the live UI. Start with the already-observed BLOCKED execution turn-5b6f2c0b8e51486d rather than manufacturing another failure; then cover failed, stopped and delivery-unverified states as bounded follow-ups.

nodes.title: Cline auth restart persistence
nodes.summary: Requires one successful supported Cline sign-in followed by durable credential verification, restart and authenticated reload.

nodes.title: Arbitrary process-death recovery
nodes.summary: Accept exactly-once recovery across executing, delivering and delivery_unverified boundaries with durable evidence and no replay.

nodes.title: Governance/check distinction
nodes.summary: precheck contains governance; npm run check remains separate and must not be described as automatically executing precheck.

nodes.title: Exact continuation instrumentation audit
nodes.summary: Optional archival extraction of delivery_response_resolved → matching instruction_received → explicit newSession:false. Non-blocking because A→B→C live behavior already closes continuation.

nodes.title: Parallel settings cleanup decision
nodes.summary: Before consolidating or removing electron/settings-module.js, prove whether any compatibility/non-production path still imports it.
